mathematical_authority.decision: The dated UCAR release artifact is authoritative because it is contemporaneous, complete, and includes the runtime payload. The Git tag is corroborating metadata only.

native_reference.rebuild_claim_boundary: byte-identical repeat on the same machine (x86-64 Linux under WSL2) and pinned toolchain; not cross-platform or cross-compiler
native_reference.one_step_reproduction_result: all generated scientific outputs and t=0/t=6 records byte-identical across the two same-host builds/runs; raw timing text excluded by documented normalization

one_step_smoke.claim: native context smoke only; no internal operator instrumentation or port/product parity

blockers: src/lfoice.F carries copyleft licence terms separate from the CM1 grant
RRTMG sources carry AER no-sale and notice-preservation terms
embedded Mersenne Twister terms must be preserved
fourteen tar-only runtime assets have no standalone license sidecar
redistribution.package_policy: Do not bundle the CM1 source tree, native physics, binary lookup tables, or reference executable. Ship identities, maps, independently written port code, and small derived oracle fixtures only after provenance review. Every bundled CM1 file or datum is listed under bundled, with its review.

bundled.review: short lines and values from text files of a release under UCAR's permissive grant (its tarball's README); src/module_mp_nssl_2mom.F carries no notice of its own; none is RRTMG, lfoice.F or a tar-only asset

bundled.source_path: CM1 r16, r17, r18 (release 18.3), r19.10 and r20.3 (their tarballs): README.namelist, CHANGES and the namelist declarations in src/
bundled.form: every key those releases declared that r21.1 does not, with its r21.1 equivalent and file:line citations; lines of r19.10, r20.3 and r21.1 are quoted (11, 4 and 8 short lines); lines of r16, r17 and r18 are not quoted but described in the record's own words and pinned by their digest
bundled.notice: NOTICE, section Other CM1 releases (r19.10 and r20.3: UCAR's permissive grant, copyright 2020 and 2021 UCAR; r16, r17 and r18: not quoted)
bundled.why: the importer reads namelists written for older CM1 releases and maps their keys to r21.1's
bundled.review: r19.10 and r20.3 carry UCAR's permissive grant (each tarball's README), the same as r21.1's, so their short lines are quoted with the notice; r16, r17 and 18.3 carry their author's earlier terms, which do not permit redistribution beyond the user's working group, so nothing of theirs is reproduced beyond the setting names a namelist uses and facts about them
